reasons: Semester 6 is an exchange semester with 0 MC, so only semesters 7 and 8 can hold courses.
Semester 7 must contain CS3227 and CS3237, using 8 of the 12 MC limit and leaving room for only one more 4 MC course.
Both CS2107 before CS3235 and CS2102 before CS3223 need two semesters, but only one prerequisite can fit in semester 7, so no plan satisfies all rules.
